field_notes.netlist_adaptation: Changes between imported reference and released fixed DUT. Model and terminal changes are not assumed electrically neutral.

netlist_adaptation.summary: Eight ideal 1 MOhm resistors became generic-poly W=0.33 um, L=5684.65 um devices; eight ideal 5 pF capacitors became 49.85 um-square MIM devices. MOS statements and top-level ports were retained. Each resistor is about 5.685 mm in electrical length; this was not an area-optimized substitution.

Four already-physical high/xhigh-poly resistors were replaced by two-terminal generic-poly instances. Nominal reference resistances were approximately retained; device family, substrate-terminal representation and model-dependent behavior changed.
netlist_adaptation.preserved_devices: MOS, BJT and MIM instance statements

netlist_adaptation.summary: Two already-physical high/xhigh-poly resistors were replaced by two-terminal generic-poly instances. The core nominal resistance changed from about 14.1849 kOhm to 14.7995 kOhm, and the startup pull-up from about 15.9 MOhm to 1 MOhm. This is an electrically adapted benchmark reference, not a name-only mapping.

Fourteen ideal capacitors became explicit MIM instances sized on a 0.005 um geometry grid. MOS statements, clock subcircuits and signal connectivity were retained; this is a physical-passive adaptation rather than an untouched source netlist.

netlist_adaptation.summary: Selected NMOS body terminals were reconnected to sourceNmos. D/G/S, device models, W/L, multiplicities and finger counts were retained. A body reconnection changes the electrical circuit; no equivalence to the original body-connected circuit is claimed. The ideal 2.8 pF compensation capacitor was replaced by a 37.27 um-square MIM instance; the initial 37.265 um proposal was rounded for PCell grid compatibility.

A team-provided bandgap was ported to explicit SKY130 MOS/PNP, high-poly resistors and MIM capacitors. Passive values and geometries were adapted during the port; source-process targets are not evidence of SKY130 validation.
A team-provided comparator was ported to SKY130 1.8 V MOS devices and fixed as a separate SKY130 task. Source-process results do not certify the ported design.
A team-provided folded-cascode OTA was ported to SKY130 devices. The input-feedback polarity was corrected for this task; no equivalence to an unmodified source-process implementation is claimed.

A team-provided two-stage OTA was ported to SKY130 devices, including explicit generic-poly compensation resistance and a MIM compensation capacitor. Passive geometry and the tested operating point were adapted during the port.
